samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Multiplies two 4-bit numbers using pipelining technique. Multiplier is stored in mul_reg[0] and multiplicand is stored in mul_reg[1]. Registers mul_reg[2], mul_reg[3] and mul_reg[4] are used for storing partial sums generated during the multiplication process. Final product is stored in mul_out.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset input.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier operand A.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier operand B.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">Number of bits in operands.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="add_in" width_description="[2*size:0]">Intermediate sum value for addition stage.</signal>
        <signal id="i">Loop variable.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="mul_reg" width_description="[4:0][2*size:0]">Array of registers for storing intermediate values.</signal>
        <signal id="product" width_description="[2*size:0]">Register to store the final product.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extending inputs by appending size zeros to their MSBs.
        wire [2*size-1:0] a_ext;
        wire [2*size-1:0] b_ext;
        
        assign a_ext = { {(size){1'b0}}, mul_a };
        assign b_ext = { {(size){1'b0}}, mul_b };
        // Generate loop index.
        genvar j;
        generate
            for(j=0;j<size;j=j+1)
                begin : mult_gen_loop
                    // Intermediate partial product register.
                    reg [(2*size):0] pp_r;
                    
                    always@(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)
                        if(~rst_n)
                            pp_r <= 'd0;
                        else if(mul_b[j])
                            pp_r <= a_ext << j;
                        else
                            pp_r <= 'd0;
                end
        endgenerate
        
        // Intermediate register array.
        integer i;
        always @(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)
            if (~rst_n)
                for(i=0;i<=4;i=i+1)
                    mul_reg[i] <= 'd0;
            else
                begin
                    mul_reg[0] <= pp_r;
                    for(i=1;i<=4;i=i+1)
                        mul_reg[i] <= mul_reg[i-1];
                end
                
        // Add of partial products.
        assign add_in = mul_reg[2]+mul_reg[3]+mul_reg[4];
                
        // Register to store final product.
        always @(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)
            if (~rst_n)
                product <= 'd0;
            else
                product <= add_in;
        
        // Assigning output port with final product.
        assign mul_out = product;
    </implementation>
</module>
